_readme: The list behind just-rice.github.io. Edit this, then run: python3 scripts/build.py. The daily GitHub Action (scripts/sync.py) adds new Pages repos and refreshes the dates on its own.

projects.name: Test Prep
projects.blurb: Adaptive practice for the SAT, PSAT, ACT and MCAT: a placement test, timed practice tests in each exam's real format, mistake review and a daily study plan.

projects.name: MEGABONK
projects.blurb: A 3D survivor-roguelike. Pick a bonker, get swarmed, auto-bonk everything and try to last twenty minutes. Works on phones too.

projects.name: GameHub
projects.blurb: Fifteen arcade classics in one place, from Snake and Tetris to Minesweeper and Wordle, all drawn and scored by hand.

projects.name: Monopolyish
projects.blurb: A full browser Monopoly with computer opponents, auctions, trading, mortgages and hotels, plus online play with friends.

projects.name: Chowka-Bhara
projects.blurb: The traditional Indian cowrie race to the centre, with a computer opponent that plays to win and online play.

projects.name: Groundish News
projects.blurb: A news reader that shows every side of a story: the same event across 66 outlets, how each side headlined it, and what one side isn't covering.

projects.name: Food is Medicine
projects.blurb: Nutrition for 1,002 foods from USDA FoodData Central, measured against your own needs, plus an honestly graded guide to medicinal herbs.

projects.name: Subtrackr
projects.blurb: A subscription tracker that knows the price is different where you live: 130 services, 465 tiers and 50 markets, all kept on your device.

projects.name: Trading Lab
projects.blurb: Test trading robots on 25 years of real US prices, for single stocks or mixes of stocks, bonds and gold, with a fair exam against overfitting and live practice trading.

projects.name: About:Blank Lab
projects.blurb: How about:blank tabs work, what they hide and what they don't, with a launcher to open any link inside one.

projects.name: traceline
projects.blurb: A synthetic-data study of the people-search genre. No scraping, no backend, nobody real. Code only.
